# Card Definition

## Summary
`CardDef` is the base class of every card: a named schema of `@field`
declarations plus up to four format components (isolated, embedded, fitted,
atom). Instances are addressable JSON documents in a realm; definitions are
exported classes in a module.

## Invariants
- A card instance's `meta.adoptsFrom` must resolve to an exported CardDef.
- Subclassing (adoption) inherits fields and formats; type queries match the
  whole adoption chain.
- `cardInfo` (name/summary/notes/thumbnail/theme) exists on every CardDef.

## Example
The concept card (`MatrixConcept/l03-cv-table`) demonstrates this: it is an
instance of the `MatrixConcept` CardDef exported from `../matrix-concept`.
Every card module ultimately imports `CardDef` (see the Used by list).

## Module
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — export `CardDef`.
